nodes.name: Claim a job
nodes.notes: Select the "Conduit claim key" Header Auth credential after import — deliberately not referenced here, since an id from another instance imports as a dangling reference. Value is "Bearer cdt_..." from pnpm claim-key:mint: the service key, not a workspace key. Every other route refuses it.

nodes.name: Claim accepted?
nodes.notes: Without this, an unauthenticated runner is indistinguishable from an idle one: a 401 has no body.job either, so it would take the same branch as an empty queue and sit there quietly forever.

nodes.name: Claim refused
nodes.notes: 401 = credential wrong or key revoked. 429 = the 5s poll floor, which on a 1-minute schedule means two runners are sharing one key.

nodes.name: Run Ollama
nodes.notes: 8 min timeout, deliberately under the server's 10 min STALE_AFTER_MINUTES. Raise one and you must raise the other.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ $json.statusCode === 200 ? JSON.stringify({ status: 'done', result: { text: $json.body.response, model: $json.body.model } }) : JSON.stringify({ status: 'failed', error: `ollama returned ${$json.statusCode}` }) }}

nodes.name: Report result
nodes.notes: No credential here on purpose. This authenticates on the 15 min HMAC token the claim returned — the API key is refused at this route even when valid, so a leaked token is worth one job.
